title: Tidy Desk level
description: One level of Tidy Desk: Tech & Setup. Save as TidyDesk/Resources/Levels/level_<levelId>.json. Validate with: python tools/check_levels.py

levelId.description: Order of the level (1, 2, 3...). Must match the file name number. Unlocking follows this order.

gridCols.description: Desk width in cells (8 is about the limit on an iPhone).

items.description: Devices / objects. Drawer order = array order. Total item area must equal gridRows x gridCols.

initialPosition.description: Top-left cell where the item starts ON THE DESK (a messy item in the wrong spot). null or absent = starts in the drawer.

correctPosition.description: Optional fixed target (top-left cell, authored orientation). The level clears only when every item that has one sits exactly there; the desk shows its outline. Absent = free fit.

imageName.description: Top-down vector asset in Assets.xcassets, snake_case (e.g. "keyboard_mechanical"). Drawn in the authored orientation (gridWidth x gridHeight). One asset name = one footprint across all levels. See ASSETS.md.

symbol.description: Optional SF Symbol shown while the asset is not in the catalog yet (e.g. "keyboard.fill"). Missing or invalid -> the category's default symbol.

category.description: Tile colour family. Optional, default peripheral.
